name: threejs-viewer-dev
description: Dev-only: TypeScript + three.js types for IDE IntelliSense on viewer/*.js. No runtime deps; build.py is the real build. Run `npm install` once; then `npx tsc --noEmit -p jsconfig.json` to type-check. The VS Code extension: `npx tsc --noEmit -p vscode-extension/jsconfig.json` and `node --test vscode-extension/test`.
